name: USB Audio Microphone
description: The `usb_audio` microphone platform receives audio from a USB audio device, such as a USB microphone, sound card or speakerphone, connected to the [USB Audio](https://esphome.io/components/usb_audio/) component.

config_entries.label: USB Audio ID
config_entries.description: The [USB Audio](https://esphome.io/components/usb_audio/) component to use. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

config_entries.label: Bits Per Sample
config_entries.description: The bit depth of the audio samples. One of `8bit`, `16bit`, `24bit` or `32bit`. Must be supported by the USB device. Defaults to `16bit`.

config_entries.label: Buffer Size
config_entries.description: The size of the buffer between the USB driver and ESPHome, in bytes. Must hold at least 40 ms of audio (e.g. `1280` bytes at 16000 Hz, 16 bit, mono). Defaults to `6400`, or to the minimum when that is larger.

config_entries.label: Num Channels
config_entries.description: The number of channels, `1` (mono) or `2` (stereo). Must be supported by the USB device. Defaults to `1`.

config_entries.label: Sample Rate
config_entries.description: The sample rate of the audio stream, in Hz. Must be between `8000` and `96000` and supported by the USB device. Defaults to `16000`.
